meta.name: why-ethereum
meta.description: Why build on Ethereum — the AI agent angle with ERC-8004 identity, x402 payments, composability, and permissionless deployment. Corrects common misconceptions about gas costs, terminology, and network status.

copy.tagline: 讲清以太坊在AI代理应用中的优势与常见误区
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在犹豫是否在以太坊上构建 AI 代理应用。
copy.tagline_en: Explain Ethereum's advantages for AI agent apps and clear up common myths.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're unsure whether to build your AI agent on Ethereum.

howto.what: 安装后，当用户询问以太坊相关问题时，Claude 会从 AI agent 角度解释为何构建在以太坊上，涵盖 ERC-8004 身份、x402 支付、可组合性、无许可部署，并纠正 gas 成本、术语和网络状态的常见误解。
howto.when: 当用户询问为何选以太坊、gas 费高吗，或提到 ERC-8004 等概念时触发。

say.text: 为什么要在以太坊上构建？
say.note: Claude 会从 AI agent 角度回答。

say.text: 以太坊的 gas 费是不是很高？
say.note: Claude 会纠正关于 gas 成本的误解。

say.text: 解释 ERC-8004 身份和 x402 支付。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude explains Ethereum's advantages for AI agents (ERC-8004 identity, x402 payments, composability, permissionless deployment) and corrects myths about gas costs, terminology, and network status.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users ask why to build on Ethereum, question gas fees, or mention ERC-8004 and related concepts.

say_en.note: Claude answers from an AI agent perspective.

say_en.text: Are Ethereum gas fees too high?
say_en.note: Claude corrects misconceptions about gas costs.

say_en.text: Explain ERC-8004 identity and x402 payments.
